canonical_statement: Let T > 0 and X be a real-valued process indexed by [0,T] on a probability space. If alpha,beta > 0 and E[edist(X_s,X_t)^alpha] <= C*edist(s,t)^(1+beta) for every s,t, then X has a fixed-time almost-everywhere modification Y whose paths are almost surely gamma-Holder for every 0 < gamma < beta/alpha.
domain_and_universes: Omega : Type u with a measurable space; probability measure P; T, alpha, beta : Real; C : NNReal; X,Y : Set.Icc 0 T -> Omega -> Real; gamma : NNReal; proposition in Prop
conclusion: There exists one process Y such that forall fixed t, X t = Y t almost everywhere under P, and forall gamma : NNReal with 0 < gamma and gamma < beta/alpha, almost every path of Y has some finite HolderWith constant at exponent gamma.
